sections.text:
- Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
- Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
- Target: all allies. Recovers 25 Cost.
- The following applies when the activator is one of the Lancer/Berserker Classes. Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 60 seconds.
- Target: yourself. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Also applies the "Increases the stats of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds" effect to Classes other than Lancer and Berserker.
